# Kulsums Collection

> Timeless style for a brighter you. Sarees, suits, and everyday favourites, picked by hand and delivered to your door.

Kulsums Collection is an online Indian ethnic-wear shop. It sells sarees, suits, and kurtis. Prices are in Indian rupees and include GST where applicable. ₹79 shipping, free above ₹1,499. Delivery in 4–7 working days. Ships across India.

## Shop
- [All products, plain list](https://kulsumnazmeen2016.github.io/kulsums-collection/catalog.html): every product with price, fabric, sizes, colours, and a link

## Customer information
- Shipping: ₹79 shipping, free above ₹1,499. Delivery in 4–7 working days. Ships across India.
- Returns and exchanges: Exchanges are accepted within 3 days of delivery for unused items with original tags and packaging. Sale items and customised pieces cannot be exchanged. To start an exchange, message us with your order number and a photo of the item.
- Payment: UPI.
- Order tracking: https://kulsumnazmeen2016.github.io/kulsums-collection/?page=track (needs the order number and mobile number)
- Contact: see the Contact page. Hours: Monday to Saturday, 10 am to 7 pm
- About: Kulsums Collection brings together sarees, suits, kurtis, and accessories from trusted makers and wholesalers. Every piece is checked before it is listed, and we are always a message away if you need help choosing.

## Common questions
- **How long does delivery take?** Orders are packed within 1–2 days and usually arrive in 4–7 working days.
- **Do you offer cash on delivery?** Yes, cash on delivery is available on most orders. You will see it at checkout.
- **Can I return or exchange?** Exchanges are accepted within 3 days of delivery for unused items with tags. Message us with your order number to start.
- **Are colours the same as the photos?** We photograph in daylight, but screens vary, so the shade may differ slightly.
